name: Sayoko
source:
Sayoko.
Mistress of the hall in an isolated sea island.
Age unknown. unidentified.
Fed up the desire of those who stray into the island and degenerate.
That was everyday for Sayoko.
Such daily life continued for hundreds of years, thousands of years.

On the other hand, the birthrate has been decreasing in Japan.
As measures against declining birthrate, the government will implement various policies, but we can not produce much results, the declining birthrate has progressed, and finally the birthrate fell to 0.98.
Yoko Mabuchi Minister in charge of countermeasures against declining birthrate attempts to contact a certain "woman" to solve this crisis situation ...
That ... ... that "Sayoko".
translation:
小夜子。
孤悬海外的岛屿上，一座宅邸的女主人。
年龄不详，身份不明。
她满足误入岛屿之人的欲望，令他们不断堕落。
这便是小夜子的日常。
这样的日子延续了数百年，乃至数千年。

另一方面，日本的出生率不断下降。
政府为应对少子化实施了多项政策，却始终收效甚微。少子化持续恶化，出生率最终降至0.98。
为化解这一危局，少子化对策担当大臣马渊洋子试图与某位“女性”取得联系……
那个人……正是“小夜子”。
